annotations.text:
SET UP

A workspace owns its sources, its ontology and its graph — "workspace" and "domain" are the same thing here, one word only.

Tables and documents are both first-class sources. The run config is where you decide how hard the model leans on each, and where it will stop for you.

Data sources carries the re-extraction path. Every source shows when it was last extracted and whether it has drifted since; the amber banner selects the drifted ones for you. Two separate exits: Update v5 folds changes into the existing ontology and only re-asks about what moved, New extraction starts a clean draft.

RUN AND REVIEW

Runs go to the background the moment you start them. The runs list is the place you come back to — filter by "Needs review" and work the queue.

The stepper on the run page is clickable: past stages show what they produced, future ones show what they will do and that they are blocked.

Gate 1 is the screen that matters most. Concepts and relationships share one gate with two tabs, because a relationship only makes sense once both its ends are accepted.

SIGN-OFF AND OUTPUT

Gate 2 checks the ontology against the questions it is supposed to answer, and is honest when it cannot answer one.

The ontology and graph screens are drafted rather than designed down — they are the least settled part of this canvas and the easiest to replace once the two gates feel right.
